_about: Item 1 (Business) extraction exceptions. 'custom': filers whose 10-K has no usable 'Item 1. Business' heading (annual-report style layouts); a section starts at a line whose whole text matches a 'start' pattern and ends at the next line matching an 'end' pattern (regex, case-insensitive, full line); the first section with 300+ words wins. 'relaxed': tickers allowed the relaxed Item 1 heading rule. Every custom or relaxed extraction must beat that ticker's Yahoo summary on the quality check, or it stays on Yahoo.

C.why: Citi files its annual report as the 10-K; the business description sits under 'Overview' with a cross-reference index instead of Item headings

MS.why: Morgan Stanley's body headings are 'Business' / 'Risk Factors' without Item numbers

GE.why: GE uses a cross-reference index; the business is described under its own section names

HON.why: Heading not found by the line-start rule; match 'Business' as a stand-alone heading line

INTC.why: Intel's 10-K is organised by its own sections with a cross-reference index

MCD.why: Heading not found by the line-start rule; match the stand-alone heading lines
